title: Globe UI overhaul — structure
question: Overhaul the 3D globe chrome inside the Cartographic Situation Room. The roll assigned Indexed Instrument Modes. Keep it, take a fused alternate, or re-roll. WebGL globe, country select, layers, events, and dossier routes stay.

options.label: Indexed Instrument Modes
options.lineage: Situation-room briefing binder · one instrument page at a time
options.body: Full-bleed globe always. Compact numbered tabs (01 Statistics · 02 Layers · 03 Events · 04 Feed) open exactly one instrument surface; the rest stay off-stage. Pin callouts stay sparse and paginated. Fixes the clogged-screen problem by making chrome mutually exclusive. Signature interaction: key or click an index and the prior module folds away while the new one docks to a fixed rail.

options.label: Live Gate Board
options.lineage: Boarding-pass + departure board, dressed in WatchTower ink
options.body: Bottom console becomes a live ranked board: event rows reorder by recency/severity, layers sit as LED switches in a pass strip, stats collapse into a scannable block. Change state holds steel highlight until noticed. Stronger for scanning incidents; denser bottom edge than Indexed Modes.

options.label: Aperture Instruments
options.lineage: Cut apertures / peepholes into the HUD
options.body: Stats, layers, and news preview through small square registration apertures on the map frame. Tap expands that aperture to a full instrument panel; back shrinks it to a porthole. Globe stays dominant; discovery is spatial. Risk: more motion and a less familiar Operate pattern.
